description: Prior Approval (Class MA) to change use of ground floor from commercial, business and service use (Class E) to 1 x self-contained residential unit (Class C3)
decision_conditions: The proposed development would result in the provision of substandard and poor form of living conditions for future occupiers in terms of failing to meet the minimum space standard for bedrooms, to the detriment of the well being of future occupiers of the development. Having regard to The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, Article 3 Paragraph (9A), the change of use would not provide an acceptable standard of residential accommodation, contrary to the Technical housing standards (2015), London Plan (2021) Policy D6 and policy LP17 of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020).

In the absence of a suitable undertaking to secure that the occupiers of the new residential units would not be able to apply for on street parking permits, the proposals would have an adverse impact on street parking conditions, highway safety,  sustainable modes of transport and would contribute to congestion in the surrounding area contrary to Policies T1 and T4 of the London Plan (2021) and Hackney Local Plan Policies LP43 and LP45. Having regard to The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, Part MA.2(2)(a), the change of use is not supported on the basis of adverse impact on on-street parking conditions and highway safety.
